name: Accounts Payable Date to Date
query:
SELECT
    gle.party                        AS "Supplier:Link/Supplier:300",
    SUM(gle.credit)                  AS "Total Invoiced:Currency:140",
    SUM(gle.debit)                   AS "Total Paid / Return:Currency:160",
    SUM(gle.credit - gle.debit)      AS "Outstanding:Currency:140"
FROM `tabGL Entry` gle
JOIN `tabAccount` acc ON acc.name = gle.account
WHERE gle.docstatus = 1
  AND gle.is_cancelled = 0
  AND gle.party_type = 'Supplier'
  AND acc.account_type = 'Payable'
  AND acc.is_group = 0
  AND gle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY gle.party
HAVING ROUND(SUM(gle.credit - gle.debit), 2) <> 0
ORDER BY 4 DESC
